newsitem.title: UK: UK's SFA expels SAfrican shares trader, fines bank.
newsitem.headline: UK's SFA expels SAfrican shares trader, fines bank.

text.p: Britain's Securities and Futures Authority said on Thursday it had expelled a former senior trader with Henry Ansbacher & Co from its register over misuse of $70,000 of the bank's money.

It said David Crook, a senior dealer in South African gilts and gold shares, transferred $70,000 to an associate in Zimbabwe in August 1994 on the pretence that the money was needed as margin funds for a new proprietary trading account.
"In fact no such trading account existed and the payment was really an unauthorised transfer of funds to an associate of Mr Crook in Zimbabwe," the SFA said in a statement.
The SFA said it has also fined Ansbacher 20,000 stg for "supervisory and procedural failures" in the affair.
